Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Novalis Food SaaS concept showroom. Fictional brand 'Sillage' customer service workspace, deep plum left sidebar, soft ivory workspace, copper and muted lavender accents. No AI-origin labels, no real client logos, no physical device frame, no watermarks.
